groups.name: usb
groups.why: micro-B receptacle P1 (declared pose, west edge) with its shield-to-GND 1M R1 and the back-side solder pads P2-P5 that carry the same +5V / D- / D+ / GND (an alternate USB attachment)

groups.name: ftdi
groups.why: FT2232H USB bridge U4: its 93C46 config EEPROM U1 with the R2 pull-up array and R6, the 12k REF R8 (pin 6), the RESET# pull-up R9 (pin 14), the VPHY/VPLL ferrite filters (L2/C12/C6 on pin 4, L1/C13/C9 on pin 9), the +1V8 VREGOUT/VCORE decaps C7/C10/C14/C16/C17, five +3V3 decaps for its VCCIO/VREGIN pins (C18-C22), C4 for the EEPROM's VCC, and the 12 MHz oscillator U7 (its OSCI pin 2 is U4's; C29 is the oscillator's VDD decap); R25 is the strap pull-down on xFIFO_D3 (pin 41)

groups.name: bridges
groups.why: back-side solder jumpers that each tie one FT2232H FIFO/port-B pin (U4 pins 19, 38-48, 52-55) to an FPGA pin (U6 pins 6, 9-11, 18-21, 23, 25-27, 37); they sit between the two chips, on B.Cu where they already are

groups.name: fpga
groups.why: iCE40UP5K U6 with its VCORE decaps (pins 5/30: C23 C25 C28 C36 C37 C38), the VCCPLL RC filter R10/C24/C26 (pin 29), VCCIO_2 decap C27 (pin 1), VCCIO_0|1 decaps C30/C31 (pins 22/33), the VPP_2V5 diode D2 and cap C35 (pin 24), the B-side supply-select jumpers J14 (+1V2 to VCORE), J17 (VCCIO_2 1V8/3V3) and J19 (VCCIO_0|1), and the CRESET circuit: pull-up R19, series R26 from the FTDI, header J28

groups.name: flash
groups.why: W25Q128 config flash U5 with its R11 pull-up array (CS/WP/HOLD/SCK), its +3V3 decap C1, the B-side jumpers J15/J16/J18 that tie its MOSI/MISO/CS to the FPGA's SO/SI/SS_B, and the flash header J20 (declared pose, south edge) that carries the same SPI nets

groups.name: power
groups.why: the two LDOs from +5V (USB VBUS): U2 3.3V and U3 1.2V, their +5V input caps C2/C8, U2's NR cap C3 (pin 4) and EN RC C39/R3 (pin 3), U3's NR cap C11 (pin 4), the output caps C5 (+3V3) and C15 (+1V2), the DNP +3V3 bulk sites C32-C34, and the power-on LED D1 with its resistor R5 from +3V3

groups.name: pmod1a
groups.why: PMOD 1A socket J21 (declared pose, north edge) with its two 33R series arrays R20/R23 to the FPGA

groups.name: pmod1b
groups.why: PMOD 1B socket J22 (declared pose, north edge) with its two 33R series arrays R21/R24 to the FPGA

groups.name: pmod2
groups.why: PMOD 2 socket J23 (declared pose, east side of the main board) with its two 33R series arrays R4/R22 to the FPGA

groups.name: breakaway
groups.why: the snap-off PMOD board east of the slot: its 2x6 header J24 (declared pose) wired to PMOD 2, three buttons SW2-SW4 with their 10k array R16, five LEDs D6-D10 with their 330R array R17 and R18; all on /P2_*x nets, so they belong on that board, buttons toward its east edge

groups.name: ui
groups.why: user button SW1 (declared on the west edge) with its pull-up R13, and the status LEDs: CDONE D3 with its pull-up R12, D4/R14 on LEDG, D5/R15 on LEDR, plus the LEDG solder pad P6

groups.name: rgb
groups.why: the RGB LED D11 on the FPGA's RGB current-sink pins 39-41, its anode jumper J30 (B.Cu, to +5V), and the RGB LED header J25 (declared pose, south edge) that carries the same three LED nets

groups.name: ext_top
groups.why: a self-contained adapter on its own /ET_* nets and its own ground /ET_GND (no net to the rest of the board): 2x4 RGB-LED socket J31, BSS138 level shifter Q1 with pull-ups R7 (3V3) / R27 (5V), WS2812 header J32

groups.name: ext_bot
groups.why: a self-contained adapter on its own /EB_* nets and ground /EB_GND (no net to the rest of the board): 2x4 socket J33 to a 2x2 add-on socket J34 with pull-ups R28/R29
